llamaindex_http_pdf.summed_process_rss_note: peak of a SUM of per-process RSS (collector.py:360,378). Shared copy-on-write pages are counted once per mapping process, so with N forked workers this OVER-counts by roughly the sharing factor. NOT comparable to Leela's or Shashi's figures.
llamaindex_http_pdf.comparable_note: Leela reads cgroup memory.stat anon (cgroup_sampler.py:55-62); Shashi reads the Docker API memory_stats.stats.rss, else usage-file (cstats.py:132-140). Both are cgroup-level: the kernel charges a shared page once per cgroup, not once per process. Quote anon against theirs.
